text: The user-size Preferences::GetInt call does not assign rv, but the next NS_FAILED(rv) check remains. At that point rv is the successful charset-language lookup result. The default-branch preference read updates rv separately. The plain-body caller appends fontPixelSize to CSS if the helper returns success, so the dropped assignment matters to its result contract. This identifies an unchecked fallible read within the exact source; it does not show that a normal profile lacks its font preference or reproduce bad rendering. No font, preference-failure or MIME test ran.
title: GetMailNewsFont checks a stale result after its user font-size preference read
